subQuests.subQuestName: Find where the sound of the cannon is coming from

746850101.text: Reducing the power to this level should be sufficient, the bubbleballs will be able to break the targets, an excellent balance of entertainment and safety...

746850102.text: Bubbleballs? Entertainment? Oh, so it's a toy water cannon! That's a relief...

746850103.text: Though... Doesn't this water cannon look familiar? Have we... seen it somewhere before?

746850105.text: Maybe it's because its shape is so unusual, it looks like a Spinocrocodile... The moment Paimon sees it, she just wants to give it a nickname like "Crococannon"...

746850106.text: Crococannon? The name's not bad! "Croco" is almost like... the sound of cannonballs! Concise, easy to understand, and memorable... I think it's an excellent suggestion!

746850107.text: Looks like you two are interested in this watercannon! How would you like to be my first guests?

746850112.text: Oh! Paimon thinks she can guess what you're gonna say next—

746850113.text: You've just finished making adjustments to the watercannon, and were just planning to find some people to test it out and give you some feedback?

746850114.text: Absolutely and completely correct! You guys are the real deal, you must have worked together with many in the past. I anticipate no difficulties in cooperating with you!

746850115.text: Allow me to introduce myself. My name is Brest, and I am a former naval artillery engineer from the Fontaine Research Institute's armaments research team, currently unemployed.

746850116.text: In order to make a living, I've been fiddling with this "Improved Crocomorph Vortex-Based Crocodilian-Armored Heavy Naval Battleship-Style Recreational Water Blasting Cannon" in the hopes of opening a water park...

746850117.text: Waitasec, a naval artillery engineer... unemployed... a water park? Paimon's brain is swimming in a sea of confusion...

746850109.text: That's right! Paimon remembers now, we saw the Crococannon back in the Veluriyam Mirage! But the person operating it... doesn't look like Mr. Chatillon?

746850110.text: Monsieur Chatillon!? You know of the legendary watercannon designer Chatillon!? ...That means you two must truly be experts in the field!

746850111.text: Looks like you and this watercannon have quite the connection! How would you like to be my first guests?

746859901.text: Huh? It sounds like something exploded... Is there a fight happening nearby?

746859902.text: Hmm? It seems like it came from that direction. Come on!
